services.name: Boat Charters
services.desc: Best Boat Rentals & Charters in the Hampton Area. Voted top boat rental and charters. Book your fun today! Private charter as low as $300 an hour. Booking a private boat charter with Westhampton Beach Boat Charters is a great way to throw a fantastic party with your friends, colleagues and/or family on the calm bay waters of the Hamptons and Westhampton Beach. You’re welcome to BYOB and food aboard. Boarding is easy… launch at your place or our location at Stevens Park Yacht Basin where there is free parking and a wheelchair accessible dock. If you cancel at least 7 days prior to scheduled trip, there will be no charge. There will be a 50% cancellation fee if you cancel less than 7 days
